name: twig-language
description: Snippets, Syntax Highlighting, Hover, and Formatting for Twig

twig-language.formatting.description: Enable Twig document and selection formatting. Changes apply immediately.

twig-language.braceLine.description: If true an empty line will be inserted after opening curly braces and before closing curly braces.
twig-language.braceLine.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.10.0. The new Twig formatter preserves source tokens and uses Prettier defaults for supported embedded JavaScript/CSS. See the migration guide in README.

twig-language.bracePadding.description: Inserts a space after the start of a container and before the end of the container if the contents of that container are not indented; such as: conditions, function arguments, and escaped sequences of template strings.
twig-language.bracePadding.deprecationMessage: Unused since 0.10.0. The new Twig formatter preserves source tokens and uses Prettier defaults for supported embedded JavaScript/CSS. See the migration guide in README.

twig-language.braceStyle.description: Emulates JSBeautify's brace_style option using existing Pretty Diff options.

twig-language.braces.description: Determines if opening curly braces will exist on the same line as their condition or be forced onto a new line.

twig-language.wrap.description: Preferred width for HTML attributes and embedded code. 0 leaves HTML attribute wrapping unchanged and uses 80 for embedded code. Literal text is never reflowed.

twig-language.embeddedFormatting.description: Format safely parseable script/style bodies with bundled Prettier. Ambiguous Twig-generated bodies stay unchanged.

twig-language.ignore.description: Skip formatting matching file paths. Supports *, ** and ? globs, for example **/vendor/** or legacy.twig.

twig-language.formatTimeout.description: Maximum formatting time in milliseconds. Timeout cancels the worker and returns no edits.
